body.x: ABROSS will participate in CES2019 EUREKA PARK, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA,from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019. "MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT& MIK NIGHT" # 52843) to showcase the non-face-to-face payment system'GUAVA'.

Founded in 2015, ABROSS is acompany that develops solutions for restaurants, cafes, etc. and is committedto developing systems for small businesses. As a result, we have succeeded indeveloping 'GUAVA' system which can use non-face-to-face payment servicewithout purchasing a separate device such as kiosk by combining POS and mobile.

'GUAVA' is a system in which whena consumer orders a desired menu with a mobile app, the order details aretransmitted directly to the store POS. Consumers no longer need to queue infront of a kiosk for ordering, and owners can save money on labor costs as wellas labor costs. The billing system also has unlimited potential forcompatibility with all operating systems.

ABROSS's main export partners arethe United States and Australia. The company, which is participating in the CESwith the Daejeon Information Culture Industry Promotion Agency, expectsdelivery contracts or business agreements with buyers who are providingplatform services in the corresponding countries or are engaged in paymentsystem related business.
In the future, ABROSS willincrease the satisfaction of consumers and employers by expanding untriedfunctions and expand service areas to expand into global platforms.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technologycompanies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate.
